title: NATCO Pharma's Hyderabad Plant Gets 7 Observations in USFDA Inspection

contentHtml:
Hyderabad: NATCO Pharma Limited has announced the conclusion of a US Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) inspection at its formulation manufacturing facility in Kothur, Hyderabad, with the regulator issuing seven observations in Form 483.

In a regulatory filing, the company said the USFDA conducted the inspection from November 12 to November 20, 2026.

Following the inspection, the company received seven observations in Form 483. NATCO Pharma said it believes the observations are procedural in nature and expressed confidence in addressing them comprehensively within the stipulated timelines.

The company has stated that it will take the necessary steps to respond to the observations within the prescribed timeframe.

NATCO Pharma Limited, headquartered in Hyderabad, is engaged in the development, manufacturing and distribution of generic and branded pharmaceuticals, specialty pharmaceuticals, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and crop protection products.

The research-driven pharmaceutical company has a strong presence in oncology and focuses on targeted therapies in the domestic market, along with limited-competition molecules in the US market.

NATCO Pharma operates manufacturing facilities approved by several leading regulatory authorities, including the USFDA, Brazil's ANVISA, Health Canada and the World Health Organization (WHO). Its products reach more than 50 global markets.
